correctness.summary: Finite-dimensional blocks have the normalized-trace obstruction and the Shen-Wang-Zhi uniform matrix bound; infinite-dimensional blocks have Liu's uniform compact-operator factorization, which extends to nonseparable Hilbert spaces by reduction to a separable reducing subspace. The square-root coordinate estimates force the chosen factors to remain in the c0-sum. The trace map then gives the exact kernel, quotient, distance, and bounded-trace descriptions.

limitations: The classification is restricted to annihilator C*-algebras.
No optimal universal factor constant is claimed.
The proof depends on the recent uniform matrix and compact-operator commutator theorems.
Older or poorly indexed dual-C*-algebra and operator-ideal literature may contain equivalent special cases.
Independent audit has not been performed.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The two recent source theorems treat individual matrix or compact-operator blocks. Searches for single commutators in annihilator/dual/compact C*-algebras, c0 direct sums, finite-block trace obstructions, and older compact-operator commutator literature did not locate the global single-commutator classification, universal c0 gluing, exact distance formula, or quotient identification. Older literature under different terminology remains a residual risk.

review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.

value.summary: The result upgrades the newly solved compact-operator commutator problem to a complete theorem for all annihilator C*-algebras: the nonlinear single-commutator set is exactly a closed trace kernel of commutator width one, with an isometric c0 quotient and exact distance formula.
